set.body: Implement the cross-built atlas core: AtlasRef/provenance, Region/RegionIndex metadata, immutable AtlasRegistry and standard descriptors, VolumeAtlas over ClusteredNeuroVol, transform-route planning, coordinate lookup, parcel reduction, overlap, adjacency, and toy tests for JVM/Scala.js. Likely paths: modules/atlas/shared, modules/atlas/README.md, build.sbt, README.md, docs/ecosystem-port.md.
set.title: Atlas shared core, registry, and parcel operations
